name: crux-mods
description: Opt-in Claude Code mods for crux: a run dashboard that shows the active promptbook run above the prompt and in a /crux-dashboard pane. crux-mods reads the text and origin kind of every prompt you submit, keeps none of it, and stops reading when read_prompts is off.

read_prompts.title: Read prompts
read_prompts.description: Read the text and origin kind of each prompt you submit, so that a request such as "show the run" opens the run dashboard pane. crux-mods keeps none of it. When off, crux-mods reads no prompt; the band, the pane and /crux-dashboard keep working.
